scope.strict_rule: Parse the final <result> JSON and require exact equality with json.loads(source_record.answer); timeout and failed attempts are incorrect.

decision.rule: select tp1x2 iff B timeouts <= A timeouts and B average 60-minute-capped runtime < A
decision.accuracy_assumption: Deployment topology is assumed not to change the model's underlying answer-quality distribution; strict accuracy remains reported but is not used in this speed-based selection.
